description: The tin_roundtrip input through two writers with an LOD filter. The reader gives dem:tin geometry no LOD of its own, so the writer takes it from the owning relief object's dem:lod (1): the writer filtering to [1] must keep the terrain, and its expectation equals tin_roundtrip's; the writer filtering to [2] must write no document (unexpectedOutputValidation fails the case if filtered_out.gml appears), reporting the feature as citygml.empty_geometry. New-world only: the legacy writer has no terrain support.
